rules.name: opens the menu at the pointer on a secondary click and focuses the menu
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts
rules.note: Preventing the contextmenu event keeps the browser's own menu closed. The menu is a manual popover shown with showPopover(); its top-left corner is placed at the pointer (clientX, clientY) through --menu-top and --menu-left in px, moved left or up by its own size where it would cross the viewport edge less --overlay-edge, and --menu-max-width holds the viewport width less two edges. No item is focused until an arrow key moves into the menu.

rules.name: opens the menu at the focused element on Shift+F10 and focuses the first enabled item
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts
rules.note: The keydown is handled on .context-menu, so any focused element inside the area opens it. The menu is placed below the focused element, aligned to its inline start, as a dropdown menu is placed below its trigger. Preventing the keydown keeps the browser from firing its own contextmenu; a contextmenu that still arrives while the menu is open is prevented and changes nothing.

rules.name: opens the menu at the focused element on the ContextMenu key and focuses the first enabled item
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts

rules.name: moves focus from the menu to the first enabled item on ArrowDown
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts
rules.note: ArrowUp from the menu moves to the last enabled item; Home and End go to the first and the last.

rules.name: moves focus to the next enabled item on ArrowDown and wraps from the last to the first
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts
rules.note: ArrowUp moves to the previous enabled item and wraps from the first to the last. Items that match :disabled or [aria-disabled="true"] are skipped, as in a dropdown menu.

rules.name: closes on Escape and returns focus to the element that had it when the menu opened
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts
rules.note: After a secondary click, the element that had focus is the one the press focused, or the body when it focused nothing.

rules.name: closes when an item is chosen and returns focus to the element that had it when the menu opened
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts
rules.note: The item's own click handler runs first; if it prevents the default action the menu stays open.

rules.name: closes on a press outside the menu
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts
rules.note: The pointerdown target is any node outside the menu, the area included: a secondary press on the area closes it and the contextmenu that follows opens it again at the new place. A focusout whose relatedTarget is outside the menu, and a blur of the window, close it the same way, without moving focus.

rules.name: keeps the browser menu closed and its own menu open on a secondary click inside the open menu
rules.source: ContextMenu.svelte in kandan-ui-svelte, built to these rules, with DropdownItem.svelte, menu.ts and roving.ts
